values.note: A permit and reservation are always required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/weiser/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Weiser State Forest's Greenland Tract (off US 209 near Williamstown) has two drive-in roadside sites: G001 on Radar Road beside the AT&T (PP&L) Trail, back-in, max vehicle length 34 ft on a 34-ft gravel driveway at a severe grade, site 60 ft; and G003 on Nevin Slusser/Chestnut Road, back-in 25-ft driveway (Tent Site only). G002 and G004 are hike-in tent sites. Up to 10 people per site.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880253&siteId=23651 ('Max Vehicle Length: 34', 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Driveway Length: 34', 'Driveway Grade: Severe', 'Site Length: 60', 'Looking For Category: RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site', 'on Radar Road in the Greenland Tract ... adjacent to the AT&T (PP&L) Trail') + ReserveAmerica site pages siteId 23652/23659/23660 (G003 'Driveway Length: 25', 'Tent Site'; G002/G004 'Roadside Hike-in'), read 2026-10-20

note: Weiser State Forest's Greenland Tract, off US 209 near Williamstown: two drive-in motorized roadside sites (G001 on Radar Road, back-in for vehicles up to 34 ft on a steep gravel driveway; G003 on Chestnut Road) plus two hike-in tent sites, in forested uplands. No water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 570-875-6450. --Claude

Note corrected: designated roadside sites, not dispersed camping. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate; no year-round statement (booking site: 'Open through Dec 31 2026').
